items.title: Samsung Enters Open-Ear Market With Clip-On Galaxy Buds On
items.summary: Samsung's first clip-on, open-ear wireless earbuds wrap around the outer ear instead of sealing the canal, using TwinBoost speakers, Audio Leakage Reduction and up to 9.5 hours of playback. Priced at KRW 299,000, they launch in South Korea on October 27 with Gemini Live and head-gesture controls.

items.title: Bose Ultra Open Earbuds 2nd Gen and Sport Open Arrive
items.summary: Bose refreshes its open-ear lineup with the Ultra Open Earbuds (2nd Gen) at $299 and the Sport Open at $199. Both add longer battery life, improved drivers, SpeechClarity calls and wireless charging; the Ultra adds Cinema Mode and aptX Adaptive via Snapdragon Sound, with sales starting October 1.

items.title: Fairphone Fairbuds 2 Bring Modular Repair and LDAC at EUR 119
items.summary: Fairphone's Fairbuds 2 are true wireless earbuds with seven user-replaceable parts, a 100% PFAS-free exterior and LDAC hi-res support. They offer up to 45dB ANC, 11mm bio-cellulose drivers and a 3-year warranty, available across Europe from October 14 as the brand's most sustainable audio product yet.

items.title: Shokz OpenDots 2 Fixes Loudness While Keeping the Clip-On Fit
items.summary: The Shokz OpenDots 2 open-ear earbuds keep the comfortable clip-on design of the original but deliver much louder, clearer sound with Dolby Audio and faster quick charging. Priced at AED 699, they remain one of the easiest open-ear buds to recommend for all-day awareness listening.

items.title: Open-Ear Earbuds Boom While Traditional TWS Shipments Slip 0.7%
items.summary: Omdia's Q2 2026 tracker shows global TWS shipments fell 0.7% to 82.1 million units, the first annual decline since 2023, while open wireless stereo grew 12% to 11.1 million. Clip-on designs took 61% of OWS volume, and the sub-$50 tier surged 323% year over year.

items.title: Sony WF-1000XM6 Stays the Noise-Cancelling Benchmark in 2026
items.summary: Aggregating six published reviews, the Sony WF-1000XM6 earns strong marks for class-leading ANC, clearer calls and a smaller, more secure fit via the QN3e chip and LDAC. At $329.99 battery and codecs are unchanged from the XM5, making it best for Android and cross-platform buyers chasing silence.

items.title: CMF Buds Pro 2 Packs 50dB ANC and LDAC Into a $59 Package
items.summary: Nothing's CMF Buds Pro 2 pair an 11mm bass driver and 6mm tweeter with 50dB adaptive hybrid ANC, LDAC and a smart dial on the case for phone-free control. Reviews praise flagship-adjacent sound and 43-hour battery for the price, with the main trade-off being bass-heavy default tuning.

items.title: Noise Master Buds Open Open Pre-Bookings Ahead of India Launch
items.summary: Indian brand Noise opened pre-bookings for its first Sound by Bose clip-on earbuds, the Master Buds Open, at Rs 999 ahead of an October 23 launch at Rs 7,999. The open-ear TWS offer a 10.8mm driver, 4-mic ENC, Dynamic EQ co-developed with Bose and up to 28 hours of playback.

items.title: Anker Soundcore Sleep Earbuds 4 Ship With Real-Time Snore Masking
items.summary: Unveiled at IFA 2026 and shipping in October for $229, the Soundcore Sleep Earbuds 4 use adaptive snore masking and a 20% slimmer side-sleeping design. The $349 Pro adds in-ear PPG heart-rate tracking and a touchscreen Smart Case, with no subscription required for the sound library.

items.title: Shokz OpenFit Pro Adds Noise Cancelling to an Open-Ear Design
items.summary: Shokz's OpenFit Pro is the brand's first open-ear earbuds with active noise reduction, using OpenEar Noise Reduction and a triple-mic AI system to cut low-frequency ambient sound. Hands-on testing highlights strong comfort, 12-hour battery and wireless charging, with sound led by SuperBoost drivers and Dolby Atmos.
